versions.changelog:
- Removed LICENSE file for streamlined distribution.
- Updated setup and sync scripts (`setup.sh`, `sync.sh`)—maintenance, internal improvements, or bug fixes.
- SKILL.md updated for accuracy and alignment with latest implementation.
- No changes to user-facing behavior or commands.

Initial release of sync-notes skill: securely sync your Obsidian vault with Cloudflare R2 via rclone.

- Triggered by `/sync-notes`, with support for setup, init, status, upload/download (via glob), and bidirectional sync.
- Natural language commands (English/Chinese) are parsed for intuitive uploads and downloads.
- Built-in safeguards: encrypted storage, pre-sync backups, explicit conflict handling.
- Logs every sync; maintains single rolling backup.
- Requires `rclone`, `bash`, and the `CLOUD_NOTES_PATH` environment variable.
- Interactive setup wizard guides through first-time configuration.
